tools.name: list_profiles
tools.title: List mushroom grow profiles
tools.description: List Shroom Labs mushroom grow profiles (species and strains such as lion's mane, pearl oyster, shiitake). Each has a slug for get_profile, total grow days and a canonical URL. Culinary only by default; set include_off_menu to also list educational Off-menu profiles (always returned with a legal notice).

include_off_menu.description: Also include educational Off-menu profiles. Default false.

query.description: Optional filter on name, species or tag, e.g. 'oyster' or 'beginner'.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get a mushroom grow profile
tools.description: Get the full grow recipe for one mushroom by slug (e.g. 'lions-mane', 'pearl-oyster', 'shiitake'): every stage with days, temperature (C and F), humidity, fresh air exchange (fan) and light hours, plus chamber tips and sources.

slug.description: Profile slug from list_profiles, e.g. 'lions-mane'. A plain name like 'Lion's Mane' also works.

tools.name: search_grow_content
tools.title: Search mushroom growing guides
tools.description: Search Shroom Labs grow profiles, troubleshooting guides (not pinning, contamination, leggy stems, humidity and fresh air) and blog posts. Returns titles, short descriptions and canonical URLs to cite.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. 'mushrooms not pinning' or 'oyster kit'.

tools.name: get_chamber_guide
tools.title: Get a grow chamber guide
tools.description: Get Shroom Labs guides for automated mushroom grow chambers: which chambers work ('chambers'), installing free OpenShrooly firmware on a Shrooly chamber ('install'), what happened to the Shrooly app ('what-happened-to-shrooly'), keeping a Terrashroom running ('terrashroom'), and more. Omit topic to list all.

topic.description: Which guide. Omit to list all topics.

tools.name: grow_timeline
tools.title: Mushroom grow timeline
tools.description: Day by day timeline for growing one mushroom: each stage with its start day, end day and conditions, and the total days from start to harvest. Use for 'how long does X take to grow'.
